reason: A answers my belief that members have plenty of chains to use: it says the nearest chain is more than 20 miles away in those 14 counties. It also offers invoices I can check, a meeting before May 1, and names two pharmacies that will stop serving our members, so it reads as something I can verify rather than the usual yearly complaint. B leaves out the chain distance, adds a PBM-disclosure demand that isn't in the facts, and offers nothing I can check.
